message.content:
Filtering or purifying machinery for water falls under heading 8421.21, and the residual "other" statistical suffix is 8421.21.0000. Its multiple functions (snow melting, heating, dispensing) could suggest another heading. Under Section XVI Note 3, the principal function governs, and that function is water purification and treatment. Older rulings used 8421.21.0000 for water filtering systems, while newer schedules split out household POU/POE units. This is industrial equipment, so the "other" line, 8421.21.0000, applies.

{"hts_code": "8421.21.0000", "reason": "The system's principal function is filtering and purifying water for reuse, so it is classified as water filtering or purifying machinery under subheading 8421.21 (Section XVI Note 3), even though it also melts, heats and dispenses water."}
